services.title: Residential Roof Installation
services.short: A new roof on your home, backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
services.text: DR Roofing and Construction helps homeowners all over the Houston area with their roofing needs, and our residential roof installation systems come fully backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
services.imageAlt: Aerial view of a single-story home with a newly installed shingle roof
body: When your home needs a new roof, it is certainly an investment that you will take seriously. Hiring a seasoned roofing professional is necessary for accuracy as well as for the benefits of a warranty if your roof has one. The last thing you want is to spend time and money on a roof that falls apart in a matter of months due to poor installation.

The most important decision is the roofing company you choose. Choose correctly, and you will get a new roof installed to the highest standards and decade after decade of warranty protection. At DR Roofing and Construction, our residential roof installation systems come fully backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, which covers materials and workmanship.

Our team is trained to work with all types of roofing materials, including dimensional asphalt shingles, metal roofing, clay, stone coated steel and tile. We use only the highest-quality materials and the latest techniques to ensure that your roof is installed or repaired to the highest standards.

faqs.q: What does the price on my estimate include?
faqs.a: Our estimates include the cost of labor, materials and all taxes. Change orders will only be used when and if something was added by the customer or something that was impossible to foresee before demolition began. No change order is ever made without discussing it with the customer first.

Start dates will always depend upon the material availability and the size of the job. Plans and permits, along with what type of preparation is necessary, can also be a factor. This information is discussed during the initial consultation, and in general we only start jobs after all available material is accounted for.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: Full service roof replacement systems all over Greater Houston.
services.text: We offer full service roof replacement systems all over Greater Houston, for both residential and commercial buildings.
services.imageAlt: Aerial view of a home with a new dark gray shingle roof across several slopes
body: Need help with an older roof? At DR, we believe that a well-built roof is your home's first line of defense against damage from the elements of nature. We carefully evaluate each roof and provide a detailed outline of the process of our roof replacement.

Our project management team provides a seamless experience, and our crews show up on time. We carry general liability of up to two million dollars, and we clean up as we go: we cover all non-construction areas and clear away tools, trash and excess material.
points: Asphalt shingle, metal, clay, tile and stone coated steel
Single family, multi-family and modular homes
Turnkey projects managed start to finish
A written schedule provided with your final plans

faqs.q: How long will my project take, and will you have a schedule for me?
faqs.a: The size and complexity of your project will determine how long the job will take. When going over final plans with you, a written schedule will be provided and adhered to as best as possible. There are almost always surprises during construction that may delay the project, but we will always keep you in the loop.

faqs.q: Do you clean up every day?
faqs.a: Yes. We cover all non-construction areas and clean up any tools along with trash and any excess materials.

faqs.q: How do we keep in touch during the job?
faqs.a: You will have the contact details for your estimator, your sales consultant and the owner, Dan Burr. If any of them are unavailable, our office staff can help you.

services.title: Roof Repairs
services.short: Leaks, decking, trim and ventilation put right.
services.text: Roof leaks, worn decking, damaged fascia and soffit and poor ventilation, repaired by the same crews that install our roofs.
services.imageAlt: Aerial view of a repaired shingle roof on a home with mature trees around it
body: If you do not need a new roof, we will tell you. If all your roof needs is some tender loving care, we can help you develop and maintain the most cost-effective maintenance and repair plan possible. In the instance you do need a new roof, we will clearly explain why, and let you know what your options are.
A regular roof inspection can identify issues before they get worse, so give us a call and we will come out and look at it.

services.title: Roof Inspection
services.short: A complimentary inspection of your whole roof.
services.text: We offer full service roof inspections. A regular roof inspection can identify issues before they get worse.
services.imageAlt: Aerial view of a hipped shingle roof on a suburban home
body: Need help with a roof inspection? A regular roof inspection can identify issues before they get worse. Give us a call today to schedule your complimentary roof inspection.

After an initial conversation we schedule one of our roofing experts to perform a complimentary initial estimate. They will explain what they see as the right solution for your roof and, if warranted, suggest you follow up with your insurance company.

services.title: Gutters
services.short: Gutters, drip edges, fascia and soffit.
services.text: Gutters are one of the five things we do, alongside roofing, siding, decks and patios, and fences.
services.imageAlt: Close-up of a rain gutter along the edge of a shingle roof
body: DR Roofing and Construction is your one stop shop for your roofing and remodeling needs, and gutters are part of the same job as the roof above them. We fit them alongside drip edges, fascia board and soffit board so the water leaves the roof and keeps going.
We serve all of Greater Houston and the surrounding areas from two offices, so wherever you have the need, we are just around the corner.

services.title: Siding
services.short: Siding as part of the same remodeling job.
services.text: Siding is one of the five things we do, and it is often the next thing a home needs once the roof is sound.
services.imageAlt: The sided exterior wall and windows of a painted house
body: DR Roofing and Construction is a roofing and remodeling contractor, and siding sits in the same part of the house as the roof, the fascia and the soffit. We take it on as part of the same project rather than sending you to somebody else.

At DR Roofing and Construction we take pride in our customers' experience, quality of work, honesty and integrity, and our knowledgeable team of professionals works to make every roofing and remodeling project as hassle-free as possible.

services.title: Decks and Patios
services.short: Decks and patios, built by our own remodeling crews.
services.text: Decks and patios are one of the five things we do, alongside roofing, gutters, siding and fences.
services.imageAlt: A light wood deck with built-in benches and potted plants
body: We are your one stop shop for your roofing and remodeling needs, and that includes the outside of the house as well as the top of it. Our project management team provides a seamless experience from the first estimate to the last day on site.
If permits are needed for your project, we will obtain those for you and include the cost in your contract. We want you to have as little to worry about as possible.

faqs.q: Does every remodeling job need a permit?
faqs.a: No. Permits are typically required for plumbing, electrical, HVAC and structural work. Cosmetic renovations such as installing cabinets, painting and putting up non-structural walls generally do not require one.

faqs.q: Whose responsibility is it if my project requires permits?
faqs.a: Ours. If permits are needed for your project, we obtain them for you and include the cost in your contract, so you have as little to worry about as possible.

services.title: Fences
services.short: Fencing, one of the five services we offer.
services.text: Fencing is one of the five things we do, and it comes up on most storm jobs alongside the roof itself.
services.imageAlt: A wooden privacy fence with a gate on a sunny day
body: Fencing appears on the list of other services on nearly every job we quote, because a storm that takes shingles off a roof usually takes a run of fence with it. We handle both so you are dealing with one contractor.
We carry state-mandated workers' compensation and general liability insurance coverage, which protects our employees and our customers.

services.title: Hail Damage
services.short: Hail damage found, documented and repaired.
services.text: Hailstorms can cause serious damage to a roof. The impact from a hailstone can bruise or crack roofing shingles, potentially leading to water damage in your home.
services.imageAlt: Aerial view of a home with a newly replaced roof after hail damage
body: Need help with hail damage to your roof? While you cannot always avoid roof damage from hail, you can help to minimize the extent of damage by detecting problems early and taking action to repair or replace your damaged roof as quickly as possible.

A regular roof inspection can identify issues before they get worse. Give us a call today to schedule your complimentary hail damage roof inspection. We can work to get insurance claims approved that would often get denied.

services.title: Roof Tarp and Patch
services.short: Emergency tarping to hold a damaged roof until it is fixed.
services.text: If your roof has sustained storm, wind or hail damage or has leaks and you need emergency roof tarp to protect your home until your roof is repaired or replaced, call DR Roofing and Construction.
body: A tarp is what buys you the time between the storm and the repair. If your roof has sustained storm, wind or hail damage, or has leaks, we will get it covered so the weather stays outside while the rest is sorted out.
From there we can inspect the roof, put together an estimate and, if warranted, suggest you follow up with your insurance company.

services.title: Board Up
services.short: Windows and doors secured after a storm, or before one.
services.text: If your windows or doors are damaged due to storm debris, wind, hail or vandalism, DR Roofing and Construction can secure your property.
body: If your windows or doors are damaged due to storm debris, wind, hail or vandalism, we can secure your property so it is not left open to the weather or to anybody passing.
We also do board up services ahead of time, to prevent damage from hurricanes or tropical storms.

services.title: TPO Roofing
services.short: Single-ply membrane roofing for flat and low-slope buildings.
services.text: TPO roofing systems are quickly becoming the most popular commercial roofing systems, and in some cases they can also be used for residential homes with flat roofs.
services.imageAlt: A white low-slope roof under a clear sky
body: Short for thermoplastic polyolefin, TPO is a single-ply roofing membrane that offers excellent performance at a cost-effective price. Heat-welded seams provide superior strength. TPO's long-term heat, UV and natural fungal resistance, plus flexibility without the need for plasticizers, also make it a reliable low-slope roofing system.

As demand increases for heat-reflective and energy efficient roofing systems, you can rely on TPO single-ply roofing membranes to continue to provide resistance to ultraviolet, ozone and chemical exposure. At DR Roofing and Construction we offer competitive free estimates for TPO roofing systems.
points: Excellent seam strength from heat-welded seams
A highly reflective white surface that can help reduce energy costs
Inherently flexible, with no need for plasticizers
Naturally fungal resistant, so no biocides are required
Versatile application methods, including high wind uplift roofs

faqs.q: What types of commercial roofs can use TPO roofing?
faqs.a: Most commercial flat roofs: strip centers, education buildings such as schools and colleges, hotels and motels, religious facilities, gyms, restaurants and bars, malls, hospitals and medical centers, and court houses and most city buildings.

faqs.q: Can TPO be used on a house?
faqs.a: In some cases, yes. TPO systems can also be used for residential homes with flat roofs.

about.title: Your one stop shop for roofing and remodeling
text: At DR Roofing and Construction, we take pride in our customers' experience, quality of work, honesty and integrity. Our knowledgeable team of professionals works to make every roofing and remodeling project as hassle-free as possible. We know that choosing the right contractor can be stressful and overwhelming, but the DR team is here to help you get the protection and the beauty that your home deserves, without the headaches.

We serve all of Greater Houston and the surrounding areas with two offices. Our primary headquarters is in League City, near the corner of FM 518 and Louisiana Avenue, and our north office is on Tomball Parkway at Vintage Park. Wherever you have the need for roofing and home improvement, we are just around the corner.

Our team has years of experience in roofing and construction, and your roof will not be a training ground. We are an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, and we carry state-mandated workers' compensation and general liability insurance, with general liability of up to two million dollars.
